project: Directional organelle-dynamics platform (organellomics; Hickey/Nazarov/Smertenko Plant Physiol 2023) — vertical #3 CHLOROPLAST
design_note: Directional score = biogenesis - degradation, plus a SELECTIVE degradation sub-score built only from chloroplast-selective degradation candidates (shared_with_bulk_autophagy=False). Strategic point: like plant pexophagy (no ATG36 ortholog), Arabidopsis CHLOROPHAGY has NO strong clean ATG8 selective RECEPTOR. The selective arm here is populated only by LOW/MEDIUM-confidence CANDIDATES: ATG8-interacting plastid proteins (ATI1/ATI2), the ATG-independent CV vesiculation pathway, a QC E3 (PUB4), and the CHLORAD ubiquitin-proteasome envelope-degradation machinery (SP1/SP2/SPL2 — mechanistically distinct from vacuolar chlorophagy). Expect the selective arm to be WEAK/noisy — tier it honestly, exactly like plant pexophagy.
namespace_note: Native Arabidopsis vertical — no cross-taxa orthology mapping needed; base 8-column schema (no ortholog_* columns).

degradation.GO:0010623: programmed cell death involved in cell development

resolver_services.gene_resolution: mygene.info via genes-ontologies MCP (query_genes; scopes=symbol,alias / ensembl.gene; species=3702; AGI locus + Swiss-Prot returned). Stragglers/collisions resolved via genomes MCP (ensembl_lookup / ensembl_xrefs).
resolver_services.go_membership: QuickGO get_go_annotations (genes-ontologies MCP); per-gene distinct GO IDs intersected with the seed term sets to CONFIRM membership rather than hand-assign.
resolver_services.literature_confirmation: Selective-candidate identities and mechanisms CONFIRMED via MCP resolvers (genes-ontologies: get_uniprot_entries protein names + get_go_annotations GO terms), NOT by hand-typed citations.

selective_arm_design.confidence: LOW for ATG8/vacuolar candidates (ATI1/ATI2/CV/PUB4); MEDIUM for CHLORAD (SP1/SP2/SPL2).
selective_arm_design.expectation: Weak/near-empty selective signal expected, analogous to plant pexophagy. Report tiered, not as a clean receptor.

mechanism_caveat_chlorad_vs_chlorophagy: CHLORAD (SP1/SP2/SPL2) is ubiquitin-proteasome ENVELOPE degradation of the import apparatus; classical CHLOROPHAGY (ATI1/ATI2/CV/RCB) is vacuolar. Both are chloroplast-directed clearance and both included as selective candidates, but they are distinct pathways — the mixed mechanism further weakens a single 'selective receptor' interpretation.
mrna_proxy_caveat: Transcript abundance is a proxy. Positive net_direction = 'consistent with a shift toward chloroplast biogenesis'; negative = 'consistent with a shift toward clearance'. NOT organelle turnover rates.
